scripts.check: pnpm check:md && pnpm check:ts && pnpm check:rs && pnpm check:py && pnpm check:meta
scripts.fix: pnpm fix:md && pnpm fix:ts && pnpm fix:rs && pnpm fix:py
scripts.check:py: uv run --project python ruff check python/ scripts/ && uv run --project python ruff format --check python/ scripts/
scripts.fix:py: uv run --project python ruff check --fix python/ scripts/ && uv run --project python ruff format python/ scripts/
scripts.check:cross: cargo run -q -p netwave --example dump .cross-tmp && uv run --project python python python/scripts/dump.py .cross-tmp && node typescript/scripts/dump.mjs .cross-tmp && python3 scripts/cross_compare.py .cross-tmp && python3 scripts/check_vocab_types.py
scripts.check:meta: python3 scripts/check_license.py && python3 scripts/check_ci.py && python3 scripts/check_vocab.py && python3 scripts/check_comments.py
